test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about antibiotics?

options.text: Antibiotics are not effective against viruses.
Antibiotics are effective against bacterial diseases.
Side effects of antibiotics can include smallpox, filaria and diphtheria.
Antibiotics are not effective against cold and flu.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Side effects of antibiotics can include smallpox, filaria and diphtheria.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Side effects of antibiotics can include smallpox, filaria and diphtheria is the **wrong statement.**
 
• **Antibiotics are medicines common to prevent and treat bacterial infections**.
 
• Antibiotic resistance happens when bacteria change in reaction to the use of these medicines.
 
• Bacteria, not humans or animals, become antibiotic-resistant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b21cc74ba73af55ffe0a83932870089b190b1e45d77a0039d36fc634a9d24859.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Viruses are unlike to bacteria**; they have a dissimilar structure and a unlike way of surviving, **so ****​antibiotics are not effective against viruses. **
 
• Antibiotics kill bacteria or stop them from reproducing and spreading, so** a****ntibiotics are effective against bacterial diseases.**
 
• **Antibiotics at most fight bacteria, and not viruses, they're generally ineffective against colds**.
